terminal.title: Terminal Settings
terminal.description: Configure appearance and behavior of the terminal emulator.
terminal.custom_font_stack_hint: Enter font names in priority order, separated by commas
terminal.cjk_font_family_hint: Fallback font used for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean glyphs. Auto keeps the bundled and system fallback chain.
terminal.font_ligatures_hint: Use programming ligatures when the selected font supports them.
terminal.smooth_scroll_hint: Animate wheel scrolling between terminal rows
terminal.encoding_hint: Application default for local terminals and hosts without an override. Saved hosts can choose their own encoding.
terminal.renderer_hint: Choose WebGL or Canvas rendering. On Linux, Auto prefers WebGL but falls back to Canvas when software WebGL or unsafe WebKitGTK paths are detected.
terminal.adaptive_renderer_hint: Automatically adjusts rendering rate based on activity: Boost (120Hz+) during fast output, Normal (60Hz) for typing, Idle (1-15Hz) when inactive
terminal.show_performance_overlay_hint: Display the live render tier (B=boost, N=normal, I=idle), terminal write-event rate, and queued bytes in the terminal corner
terminal.highlight_tab_on_new_output_hint: Use a noticeable color for the icon and title of background terminal tabs when new output arrives
terminal.paste_protection_hint: Confirm before pasting multi-line content to prevent accidental command execution
terminal.osc52_clipboard_hint: Allow remote programs (tmux, vim) to write to system clipboard via OSC 52 escape sequence
terminal.osc52_clipboard_read_hint: Allow remote programs to request current system clipboard text via OSC 52. Enable only for trusted sessions
terminal.copy_on_select_hint: Automatically copy terminal text to the system clipboard once a mouse selection settles
terminal.middle_click_paste_hint: Paste the current clipboard contents with middle click when the terminal is not in mouse-tracking mode
terminal.right_click_paste_hint: Paste with an unmodified right click outside mouse-tracking mode; use Shift+right click to open the context menu
terminal.open_links_with_modifier_hint: Open terminal links only with Ctrl + click, or Command + click on macOS; disable to open links with a direct click
terminal.detect_file_paths_as_links_hint: Automatically recognize path-like terminal text as clickable files; web URLs and explicit OSC 8 links remain available when disabled
terminal.selection_requires_shift_hint: When enabled, plain drag keeps terminal interaction intact and only Shift + drag starts a text selection
terminal.backspace_sequence_hint: Application default for the Backspace sequence. Saved hosts can override it.
terminal.delete_sequence_hint: Application default for the Delete sequence. Saved hosts can override it.
terminal.free_type_mode_hint: Edit the active shell command with the mouse: click to move the cursor, double-click inside matched brackets to select their contents, drag selected command text to move it, Ctrl-drag to copy it, or Alt-drag to replace the command. Full-screen Vim, Neovim, and Emacs require the explicit OxideTerm adapter; other full-screen and mouse-tracking apps keep control

in_band_transfer.title: In-Band File Transfer
in_band_transfer.enabled_hint: Handle trzsz upload and download sequences directly inside the terminal session.
in_band_transfer.allow_directory_hint: When disabled, folder uploads and downloads are rejected before transfer starts.
in_band_transfer.max_chunk_bytes_hint: Upper limit for each trzsz data chunk in bytes.
in_band_transfer.max_file_count_hint: Maximum number of files accepted in a single transfer.
in_band_transfer.max_total_bytes_hint: Maximum cumulative transfer size in bytes for one transfer session.
in_band_transfer.runtime_note: Enabling or disabling trzsz takes effect immediately. Directory and size limits apply to the next transfer that starts after the change.

terminal.smart_copy_hint: On Windows and Linux, copy the current selection with Ctrl+C and only send SIGINT when nothing is selected
terminal.scrollback_hint: Controls how many history rows the active terminal keeps available for scrolling. Lower values reduce live terminal memory usage.
terminal.bg_enabled_hint: Master switch — turn off to disable background image without deleting images
terminal.bg_hint: Add images to the gallery, then click one to activate it. Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, and animated GIF.
terminal.bg_operation_failed: Could not update the background image gallery.
terminal.bg_scope_hint: Choose whether the image appears inside selected content tabs or behind the entire application window
terminal.bg_opacity_hint: How visible the background image is (lower = subtler)
terminal.bg_blur_hint: Blur the background image (auto-capped on integrated GPUs)
terminal.bg_fit_hint: How the image fills the selected background area
terminal.bg_tabs_hint: Choose which tab types show the background image

highlight_rules.title: Keyword & Regex Highlights
highlight_rules.description: Persist keyword or regex-based highlights for terminal output. Higher rules win when matches overlap.
highlight_rules.rule_set_hint: This is the global base selection. Connections and live sessions can override it.
highlight_rules.rule_set_delete_in_use: This rule set is used by {{name}}. Reset that connection to inherited highlighting before deleting it.
highlight_rules.semantic_coloring_hint: Automatically color commands, status phrases, numbers, timestamps, addresses, and other unstyled terminal text. Explicit ANSI styles are preserved.
highlight_rules.semantic_scheme_hint: Balanced colors every recognized class. Conservative omits generic numbers and informational words to reduce visual noise.
highlight_rules.semantic_scheme_delete_in_use: This Scheme is used by {{name}}. Change that connection before deleting it.
highlight_rules.priority_hint: Drag to reorder priority from top to bottom.
highlight_rules.empty: No highlight rules yet. Add a rule or start from a preset.
highlight_rules.preview_hint: Matches are resolved with the same priority rules used in the terminal.

terminal.command_bar_hint: Show a bottom command bar for OxideTerm suggestions, AI Ask mode, broadcast, recording, cast playback, and split actions.
terminal.command_bar_git_status_hint: Show the active repository branch in the Command Bar for local and SSH terminals.
terminal.command_bar_project_tasks_hint: Show detected project and task actions in the Command Bar for local and SSH terminals.
terminal.command_bar_focus_handoff_hint: Choose commands that should hand keyboard focus to the terminal after launch.
terminal.command_bar_focus_handoff_presets_hint: Click a command to enable or disable automatic focus handoff.
terminal.command_bar_focus_handoff_advanced_hint: Add executable names not listed above, separated by spaces or commas.
terminal.command_marks_hint: Add lightweight iTerm2-style marks for reliable commands from the Command Bar, AI, and broadcast. The terminal buffer stays unchanged.
terminal.command_marks_hover_actions_hint: Show the copy output action in the command selection toolbar.
terminal.quick_commands_hint: Show a built-in quick command library in the Command Bar.

terminal.quick_commands_confirm_hint: Ask before running a quick command from the Run button.
terminal.quick_commands_toast_hint: Show a toast after a quick command is sent.
terminal.command_specs_hint: Add Fig-compatible command completion specs. Custom specs override built-in specs with the same command name.

connections.keys_and_connections_description: Manage saved connections, imports, connection pooling, and SSH keys in one place.

ssh_config.title: Import from SSH Config
ssh_config.auto_load_hint: Show hosts from ~/.ssh/config in the command palette and session manager without importing them.
ssh_config.auto_sync_hint: Import new hosts and update previously imported SSH Config connections when the configuration changes. Manual connections are never overwritten.

importers.title: Import from Other Clients
importers.description: Preview and import connection files from SecureCRT, Xshell, Termius, MobaXterm, WindTerm, Electerm, or FinalShell. Passwords and secret fields are never imported.

idle_timeout.title: Background SSH Connections
idle_timeout.description: Configure how unused background SSH connections are reclaimed.
idle_timeout.label: Idle Reclaim
idle_timeout.hint: Background SSH connections with no open terminals, SFTP sessions, or port forwards are reclaimed after this period. Set to 'Never' to keep them alive indefinitely.

ssh_keys.description: Manage local SSH keys detected in ~/.ssh/
ssh_keys.no_keys: No keys found in default location.
ssh_keys.local_description: Detected key files under the default SSH directory. These files stay outside OxideTerm.
ssh_keys.managed_description: Keys imported into OxideTerm's encrypted secret storage and referenced by saved connections.
ssh_keys.delete_blocked_description: This key is still referenced by {{count}} connection(s). Remove those references before deleting it.
ssh_keys.delete_unused_description: This managed key is not referenced by any connection and can be deleted.

sftp.title: File Transfer
sftp.description: Configure file transfer behavior and performance.
sftp.presentation_hint: Choose whether SFTP opens as a workspace tab or as a compact remote browser in the primary sidebar.
sftp.protocol_hint: Auto prefers SFTP and uses legacy SCP only when the SFTP subsystem is unavailable.
sftp.directory_parallelism_hint: Number of files transferred at the same time during recursive folder upload or download. Parallelism remains active when speed limiting is enabled.
sftp.bandwidth_hint: Limit upload/download speed per transfer. Parallel workers in one directory transfer share the configured limit.

ide.word_wrap_hint: Wrap long lines instead of horizontal scrolling.
ide.font_size_hint: Editor font size in pixels. Empty = follow terminal.
ide.line_height_hint: Editor line spacing. Empty = follow terminal.

help.title: Help & About
help.description: Application information, keyboard shortcuts, and resources.
help.debug_logs_hint: Write detailed audit logs immediately, including button actions, module transitions, safe communication summaries, and settings changes. Leave this off to write nothing.
help.open_logs_hint: Open ./log beside the main program in your file manager
help.legal_notice_description: This notice is bundled with the app and mirrors the repository LEGAL.md file.
help.safety_authorized: OxideTerm is intended for authorized system administration, debugging, remote operations, device access, and file transfer. Use it only on systems you own, manage, or have explicit permission to operate.
help.safety_connections: SSH, SFTP, Telnet, Serial, RDP/VNC, port forwarding, and proxy-jump features connect to targets you choose. Make sure those connections, routes, and forwarded traffic are allowed by your organization and local rules.
help.safety_prohibited: Do not use OxideTerm for unauthorized access, credential attacks, evading network restrictions, covert remote control, vulnerability exploitation, destructive activity, or data exfiltration.
help.safety_privacy: OxideTerm runs as a local client by default. It does not require an account, collect telemetry, or upload terminal content, connection profiles, command history, private keys, or credentials to an OxideTerm service.
help.safety_secrets: Credentials and API keys should stay in system secure storage where supported. Before sharing logs, screenshots, exported bundles, diagnostics, or prompts, review and redact secrets, hostnames, usernames, and internal paths.
help.safety_ai: OxideSens sends only user-selected context to the configured model endpoint. Review AI suggestions and commands before execution, and do not send private keys, passwords, production secrets, or regulated data to models.
help.license: OxideTerm is open source software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
help.update_available_toast: A new version is available. Go to Settings → Help to update.
help.update_downloaded_hint: Downloaded to {{path}}. Open the package to finish installation, then restart OxideTerm.
help.installer_launched_hint: Follow the platform installer. OxideTerm will quit so the installer can continue safely.
help.replacement_scheduled_hint: OxideTerm will quit so the staged installer can replace this build, then it will relaunch.
help.update_channel_hint: Stable and Beta use separate release channels
